name: Crimson Votary
lore: A human oath-singer who spends health to power close attacks. The red debt bar records up to 40 HP paid; the special spends that debt for stronger returning blades. Paying never kills you or counts as enemy damage.

primary.name: Blood Crescent
primary.description: A close crescent costs up to 4 HP, stopping at 1 HP. Each cast adds to your debt reserve; there is no free mastery damage from paying health.

secondary.name: Red Covenant
secondary.description: Pay up to 10 HP for 45% damage reduction for 2s. Your next three damaging crescent hits within 4s heal 3 HP each. Cannot heal more than once per reserved hit.

special.name: Debt Reckoning
special.description: Five blades spread out and return. Each hits a target once overall for 9 + up to 4 damage from spent debt. Each blade can heal 2 HP on at most two successful hits. Consumes your debt reserve.

passive: Blood Reserve: Paying health grants 10% damage reduction for 0.6s. Does not stack with stronger protection.

technique.name: Sanguine Reach
technique.description: Replace melee with a 380-range spear for 22 damage. Costs 5 HP and fires every 1s; no Covenant hit healing.

attack.name: Sanguine Reach
attack.description: A straight blood spear; 5 HP cost, 1s cooldown. Stops at the first target.

final_technique.name: Scarlet Bloom
final_technique.description: Replace returning blades with an aimed 1.2s warning and a 120-radius blood blossom. 36 + up to 8 debt damage; heal 6 if it hits. No returning-hit healing.

attack.name: Scarlet Bloom
attack.description: Aim a delayed blood blossom. Consumes debt for up to 8 extra damage; heal 6 HP if at least one enemy is hit.
